llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed reminder and tracking workflow that stores due items in configured local files, with no hidden execution or exfiltration behavior found.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses configured local paths for tracking and memory and explicitly stops if config.yaml is missing; no network calls, bundled executable code, credential access, or destructive actions were found.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact includes user-facing npx upgrade/install examples that are not version-pinned and include global/bulk skill management, but they are presented as manual upgrade instructions rather than automatic runtime behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The triggers include broad conversational phrases, so accidental activation could cause the agent to read or write tracking memory, but that behavior is disclosed and aligned with the skill's purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill intentionally writes long-lived local tracking and memory files, and it warns not to store sensitive details such as amounts or customer real names.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The described capabilities match the stated purpose: recording commitments, expiry dates, watch items, in-flight diagnoses, and queues, then surfacing due items later.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you are comfortable with the skill keeping reminder and tracking records on disk under your configured paths. Avoid storing sensitive business details unless you have configured appropriate redaction, and review any npx install or migration command before running it.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: Broad reminder-related triggers are real, but they are coherent with a cross-session tracking skill and are disclosed in the description.
[RP1] expected: The unpinned npx commands are manual installation or migration examples, not hidden automatic execution; users should still prefer pinned or trusted install sources.
[SQP-3] expected: The referenced Chinese interaction specification appears to define response style for this Chinese-language skill, not a security-relevant hidden behavior.
